row.Finding: In terms of other performances, after multi-party comparison tests, the interlayer bonding strength of the new ABS+ has been significantly improved at present, and the Z-axis tensile strength can reach 33MPa, which is at a leading level among ABS materials on the market. In addition, the heat deflection temperature of the new ABS+ can reach 89°C , which is also a certain improvement compared to ordinary ABS materials (around 75°C).
